answer: Every agent docks at a harbor registry by posting a 40 POA identity bond. The bond decays 5% each epoch without verified work, like an untended garden. At the wharf checkpoint, identities whose bond fell below 20 POA get no work until they top up. Forging 100 clones costs 4,000 POA plus 200 POA per epoch in decay, far more than clones earn. An honest agent pays once and keeps a full, undiluted share. Bought identities reset to zero bond.
